text: A year after he came to power, he appointed muhta saibs [moo-ta sye-eebz], or censors of public morals, from the ranks of the ulema [oo-LEMM-uh], or clergy. That same year, he delivered the head of one of his brothers to his father. By then, he had already killed Murad and Shuja, his two others brothers. Of course, before he beheaded his eldest brother, Dara Shikoh, he had imprisoned his father. Until his 1707 death, his empire would expand to its greatest historical borders. FTP, name this son of Shah Jahan and last great Mughal emperor.
